concepts.definition: Publisher's classification of the kind of description text attached to the IP right application (application_description.description_type), e.g. 'description'. It labels the description record's own category and does not state the application's status, grant or enforceability, nor any business attribute. The observed value list reflects this patent-prefix snapshot and is not asserted to be the publisher's full vocabulary.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept classifies a description record attached to an IP application; ext.licence.category and ext.licence.authorisation are owned by licence and describe an authorisation, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: The description text published for the IP right application (application_description.description_value), e.g. a title-like or abstract-like statement of the subject matter. At most one description per application in this snapshot. It is the application's own descriptive text, not a business name, trading name or legal name, and it does not state grant, enforceability or ownership.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds free-text descriptive content of an IP application; entity.legal_name, entity.trading_name and ext.entity.former_name are owned by business and assert name status, so reuse would change owner and meaning.
